items.name: BC Spring Solving A 2023
items.information: Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to stay for longer! However, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon, so **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** for your events, just in case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.

items.name: North Jersey Speedsolving B 2023
items.information: This is a series competition with [North Jersey Speedsolving A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthJerseySpeedsolvingA2023). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for North Jersey Speedsolving A, your registration for this competition will not be accepted. The event is in North Caldwell, NJ. Please refer to the travel page for additional details. Competitors may bring at most one guest.

items.name: SacQuiet Spring 2023

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.details: Details will be disclosed privately to registered competitors

items.information: ![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png) From the organizers that brought you SacCubing, comes SacQuiet Spring 2023! **This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events.** If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [SacCubing XIV 2023,](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacCubingXIV2023/) happening on May 20th, the day before. # Lunch will be provided - The registration fee is built in to include an all-expenses paid for competitor lunch, courtesy of Domino's Pizza. If you'd like an alternative lunch, feel free to leave the venue however this portion will not be compensated.

items.name: Tampere 2023
items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. The schedule may be subject to change, so if you're leaving the venue during the day, make sure to return at least 30 minutes before your scheduled events. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Aikataulu voi muuttua, joten jos poistut kisapaikalta päivän aikana, palaa vähintään 30 minuuttia ennen lajejasi.
